meta.vintageNote: The workbook does not publish a data revision timestamp. Source version parameters and capture dates do not establish revision dates.
meta.note:
Note:
1. Criteria considered for deciding retirement age is as follows:
   a) Government Sector – Based on "Date of Retirement of Subscriber" in CRA System.
   b) All Citizen – Based on Date of Birth + 60 years.
   c) Corporate – Based on "Date of retirement", or if unavailable, DOB + 60 years.
   d) NPS Lite – GDS: DOB + 65 years; Non-GDS: DOB + 60 years.
meta.forecastNote: The source title says next five years but the workbook includes prior fiscal years. The forecast snapshot date and historical-versus-prospective row distinction are not stated. No row is interpreted as a realised exit observation.
meta.forecastWindowNote: Workbook heading says next five years; seven fiscal-year rows are retained exactly without reclassification as realised observations.
